name: cube-scanner
description: Webcam Rubik's Cube face scanner — pure, tested CV core (framework-agnostic) plus a thin browser shell

scripts.lint: biome check src view tests && eslint src
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.build:panel: esbuild view/scanner-panel.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --outfile=../app/renderer/vendor/scanner-panel.js && esbuild view/corner-panel.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --outfile=../app/renderer/vendor/corner-panel.js && esbuild view/tabletop-panel.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --outfile=../app/renderer/vendor/tabletop-panel.js
